statement.zh: 学术综合将腓尼基表述为黎凡特海岸城邦传统，并在铁器时代向西地中海殖民扩张，比布鲁斯、推罗与迦太基为其中关键节点（Aubet 2001；UNESCO 295/299/37）。
statement.en: Syntheses frame Phoenician as a Levantine coastal city-state tradition with Iron Age colonial expansion into the western Mediterranean, with Byblos, Tyre, and Carthage among key nodes (Aubet 2001; UNESCO 295/299/37).
